title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Martina Trevisan and Veronika Erjavec in the Buenos Aires, originally scheduled for November 26, 2026 at 10:00AM ET.
This market will resolve to “Martina Trevisan” if Martina Trevisan wins set 2. It will resolve to “Veronika Erjavec” if Veronika Erjavec wins set 2.
If the match begins but set 2 is not completed with a winner determined (including the match ending before set 2 is reached), this market will resolve 50-50.
If the match is canceled (not played at all) or play has not begun by December 10, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official WTA Challenger match statistics.

This market may resolve only when the listed period of play has concluded and the result can be definitively determined by the listed resolution source(s).
